messages:
matt: Heads up — seeing repeated p99 GPU stalls in us-west-2 that line up with a handful of customers. NVML shows memory pin spikes and long kernel queues, looks like cohort-42 is triggering it. rolling partial mitigation now.

jia: which pool/host is this on?

matt: shared-slice-3 in multi-tenant-gpu pool. Host IDs: 10.4.12.[21,22,23] — all running batcher v3.2.

angela: ugh. same pattern we saw back in feb but quieter. batchers pile up KV state and then the beamformer kernels starve other slices.

sam: can we do a quick isolation experiment? move cohort-42 to a fractional dedicated slice for warmups? what's the cost hit?

matt: quick calc: isolating top 8 heavy cohorts into fractional dedicated slices => ~+12% GPU hours in us-west-2 but p99 token latency drops ~30% in past runs. the tradeoff seems reasonable for customers impacted.

sasha: proposal: "cohort isolation matrix" heuristic. Start routing new sessions from flagged cohorts through a shadow-isolate route that uses soft-quarantine (no hard preempt). If metric cross threshold, escalate to fractional-dedicated assignment and evict non-critical low-priority jobs.

angela: sample policy snippet (shadow route):
```yaml
route: shadow-isolate
match: cohort_id in ["cohort-42"]
actions:
  - tag: quarantine.soft
  - target_pool: fractional-dedicated-warm
  - warmup_grace: 90s
  - fallback: best-effort
```

sam: nice. how do we detect escalation? simple p99 > 2s and gpu_mem_util > 78% over 3m?

matt: yes. monitor via metrics: gpu.kernel.queue_ms, nvml.mem_pin_pct, and per-cohort kv_cache.hit_rate. escalation if any two conditions hold for 3 consecutive 1m buckets.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-3123 (auto) — assigned to @oncall.

oncall: looked at the traces. agree with soft-quarantine first, full isolate only if escalation triggers. need a canary on two racks, not whole region.

kevin: +1 from infra. I can carve two fractional slices on rack-rw-07 and rack-rw-08 and flip route for 5% of new sessions from cohort-42 for 15m canary.

sasha: perfect. let's capture cost delta during the canary and have product own customer communications if we escalate.

matt: i'll deploy route change now (rolling). command: `infractl route apply --route shadow-isolate --cohort cohort-42 --percent 5`

jia: ping when canary finishes, i'll run the postmortem metric diff.

angela: also file a short RFC for the cohort isolation matrix so SRE/Capacity can iterate on thresholds and costs.

kevin: canary started at 3123456795 (ops). monitoring dashboard: https://dash.re/redwood/usw2/cohort-42-canary — watching nvml and p99.

matt: thanks everyone. will update thread if we need to escalate. :thumbsup:
